categories.main_business_segments: BOE Technology Group operates primarily in six business segments: Display Devices, IoT Innovation, Sensing, MLED, Smart Medical Engineering, and Other businesses. Display Devices focus on TFT-LCD, AMOLED, and Microdisplay technologies for various applications including smartphones, tablets, monitors, TVs, automotive, and VR/AR. IoT Innovation provides smart terminals and integrated solutions for smart parks, finance, and other IoT fields. Sensing covers glass-based and silicon-based sensors for smart windows, industrial and medical applications. MLED focuses on Mini/Micro LED display products for multiple applications. Smart Medical Engineering offers health management and digital hospital services. Other businesses include smart connected vehicles, industrial internet, and digital art solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor display technologies such as TFT-LCD, AMOLED, flexible OLED, and Mini/Micro LED. It employs integrated design and manufacturing methods for devices and system solutions, including soft-hard integration and system integration. BOE has developed proprietary technologies like UB Cell for LCD quality enhancement, Oxide TFT for improved performance, CHPI for low power driving, and HSR for high refresh rates. It also focuses on sensor technologies including MEMS and X-ray flat panel detectors. The company invests heavily in R&D, holding over 90,000 patents with a strong emphasis on invention patents and overseas patents. Production includes large-scale manufacturing bases across China and overseas subsidiaries.
categories.primary_customers_markets: BOE serves a broad range of customers including smartphone, tablet, notebook, monitor, TV, automotive, VR/AR device manufacturers, and industrial clients. Key markets include consumer electronics, automotive electronics, healthcare, industrial automation, and digital signage. The company also targets strategic customers in smart finance, smart parks, and healthcare sectors. Its products and solutions are used globally by leading brands and in emerging IoT application scenarios. The top five customers accounted for approximately 36% of total sales, indicating a diversified but concentrated customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: BOE operates manufacturing and R&D bases primarily in China, including Beijing, Hefei, Chengdu, Chongqing, Fuzhou, Mianyang, Wuhan, Kunming, and Ordos. It has subsidiaries and service networks in the United States, Germany, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, India, Vietnam, Mexico, Brazil, and the UAE. Its sales and service coverage spans major global regions including China mainland, other Asian countries, Europe, and the Americas. The company’s revenue distribution shows significant sales in China (46%), Asia excluding China (32%), Americas (19%), and Europe (3%).
categories.supply_chain_position: BOE operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the semiconductor display and IoT value chains. It designs, manufactures, and integrates display devices and system solutions, serving as a Tier 1 supplier to device manufacturers. The company also provides end-to-end IoT solutions and smart medical services, positioning itself as a system integrator and solution provider. Its involvement in upstream activities includes LED chip production through its strategic investment in Huacan Optoelectronics. Overall, BOE covers from component manufacturing to system-level integration and service provision.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: BOE’s strategic focus is on the 'Screen of IoT' concept, integrating display technologies with IoT applications to create a comprehensive ecosystem. It pursues innovation in semiconductor displays, IoT innovation, and sensing technologies, supported by three technology hubs. Key R&D directions include flexible OLED, Mini/Micro LED, high refresh rate displays, low power consumption, integrated sensing, and smart medical technologies. The company invests about 7% of revenue in R&D annually, emphasizing patent development and global technology leadership. It also focuses on digital transformation, green low-carbon development, and building an open collaborative innovation ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: BOE generates revenue primarily through product sales of display devices, IoT smart terminals, sensors, MLED products, and smart medical equipment. It also earns income from system integration services and professional health service solutions. The company engages in direct sales to major customers globally. Additional revenue streams include investment income, licensing, and government subsidies. The company’s revenue is predominantly from physical product sales, with a small portion from service and solution offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: BOE is a global leader in the semiconductor display industry, ranking first worldwide in LCD shipment volume and area across major application fields. It holds the top position in flexible OLED shipments and IoT-related display products like low-power and splicing displays. The company competes with other major display manufacturers and emerging Mini/Micro LED players. Its strategic acquisitions and partnerships, such as with Huacan Optoelectronics, strengthen its competitive positioning. BOE emphasizes technology leadership, scale, and ecosystem collaboration to maintain and enhance its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, BOE reported total revenue of approximately RMB 174.5 billion, a slight decrease of 2.17% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders at RMB 2.55 billion. The company’s R&D investment remained stable at around RMB 11.3 billion, about 7.2% of revenue. It operates with total assets exceeding RMB 419 billion and equity attributable to shareholders around RMB 129 billion. Despite industry challenges, BOE achieved sequential quarterly improvements in revenue and net profit excluding non-recurring items, which grew by 71.74%. The company maintains a large workforce of over 90,000 employees and continues to expand its global footprint and technology capabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: BOE’s value proposition centers on its leading-edge semiconductor display technologies combined with integrated IoT solutions, enabling smart, connected, and health-oriented applications. It differentiates through high-quality, innovative display products such as flexible AMOLED, Mini/Micro LED, and high refresh rate gaming displays. The company offers comprehensive system integration capabilities and ecosystem collaboration, delivering tailored solutions for diverse industries including consumer electronics, automotive, healthcare, and industrial IoT. Its commitment to green development and digital transformation further enhances its competitive edge and customer value.
